subtitle: 耗时的活放到后台，结果在之后的轮次里交回来，定时的活按点触发

question.zh-CN: 两个耗时任务放到后台，结果在之后的轮次里注入，两项都到了再提交简报。
question.en: Two slow jobs go to the background, their results are injected in later rounds, and the report is sent once both have arrived.

question.zh-CN: 补交成绩表导入每次都失败：看失败结果怎么注入、重试几次、什么时候判定无法完成。
question.en: Importing the late-score sheet fails every time: see how a failure is injected, how often it is retried, and when the goal is judged impossible.

exercises.title: 预算很紧：轮询、取消与重启

question.zh-CN: 全量扫描要 80 秒，只有 5 轮预算：模型轮询、取消、重启，预算用完时还在跑的任务被统一取消。
question.en: The full scan takes 80 seconds and only 5 rounds are allowed: the model polls, cancels and restarts, and the job still running when the budget ends is cancelled.

question.zh-CN: 每 5 秒触发一次 12 秒的任务，上一次没跑完就跳过这次触发。
question.en: A 12-second job is triggered every 5 seconds, and a trigger is skipped when the previous run has not finished.

question.zh-CN: 每 5 秒触发一次 12 秒的任务，上一次没跑完就排队等候，最多排 2 个。
question.en: A 12-second job is triggered every 5 seconds, and a trigger waits in a queue of at most 2 when the previous run has not finished.

exercises.title: 定时触发：有上限的并行

question.zh-CN: 每 5 秒触发一次 12 秒的任务，上一次没跑完就并行再开一次，最多同时 2 个。
question.en: A 12-second job is triggered every 5 seconds, and another run starts in parallel when the previous one has not finished, at most 2 at a time.

ui.question_help: 任务、数据和预算由参数决定；这里的文字只记为备注，不会发给模型。
